Issue 4370: how long a relay client goes without the event stream when the host's data socket dial fails.
Lab: real OpenChamber server (this branch / main) with the relay host on, a local stand-in for the relay worker
(same sync/connected/disconnected, buffering, 1012 close and 15 s stuck-control rules as apps/relay/src/relay-do.ts),
and the app's own relay tunnel client (packages/ui/src/lib/relay/tunnel-client.ts) paired as a mobile device and reading
/api/global/event through the tunnel. At 6 s the relay drops the live data socket and the next 1 or 2 host-data dials
are rejected (503) or hang. A session is created over loopback every 2 s; 'delivered' counts its session.created arriving
through the tunnel, 'missed' counts the ones produced while the stream was down.

## run-main-reject1
  0.0s tunnel connected
  0.0s event stream open (200)
  6.0s FAULT: next host-data dial rejects, then relay drops the live host-data socket
  6.0s tunnel reconnecting (relay socket closed (code 1012))
  6.0s event stream failed: relay tunnel reset: relay socket closed (code 1012)
 23.0s tunnel connected
 23.0s event stream open (200)
 53.3s [main-reject1] delivered=15 missed=10 worstDelayMs=2
 53.3s tunnel idle
## run-fix-reject1
  0.0s tunnel connected
  0.0s event stream open (200)
  6.0s FAULT: next host-data dial rejects, then relay drops the live host-data socket
  6.0s tunnel reconnecting (relay socket closed (code 1012))
  6.0s event stream failed: relay tunnel reset: relay socket closed (code 1012)
  8.0s tunnel connected
  8.0s event stream open (200)
 53.2s [fix-reject1] delivered=23 missed=2 worstDelayMs=1
 53.2s tunnel idle
